_about: Hand-read recurring schedules for parishes under targeted study. Each entry must cite the exact cached bulletin it was read from — the cache is frozen, so a truth set read from a different week is worse than none. 'excluded' holds slots the bulletin genuinely states but that belong on another parish's row; they are reported separately from real errors.

1259.source: studies/noise/cache/1259.bin — 2 August 2026, Ordinary Time XVIII, masthead 'Masses' block
1259.verbatim: Saturday: 4:30 pm (Sunday Vigil) / 6:00 pm (Sunday Vigil at Immaculate Conception) / Sunday: 8:30, 11:00 am +; 5:30 pm / Monday - Friday in the Chapel: 7:15 am, 12:00 pm +

excluded.why: '6:00 pm (Sunday Vigil at Immaculate Conception)' is printed in the Cathedral's own Masses list, but the Mass belongs to immat-con-cle, which publishes it in its own ICKSP bulletin as Saturday 18:00. SITE_EXCLUSIONS drops it when the model emits the Oratory as its own site; when the model folds it into the Cathedral's Mass list instead, nothing catches it.
